CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to identified content/emergence.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/access marker (origin), and a separate status distinction are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Explicit identification of content (red) and its positional attribute is present.

D.rationale: The report separately lists the identified content (red positions) and a status/organization attribute (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: An explicit organization/access description (origin/provenance) is provided for the identified content referent.
